sentences.en: The soldier was wounded in the leg and couldn't move.
sentences.zh: 那名士兵腿部中弹，无法移动。

sentences.en: In the evening my pigeon returned to me wounded seriously.
sentences.zh: 傍晚时分，我的鸽子严重受伤回到了我这里。

sentences.en: The sun has always wounded the eyes of its worshippers.
sentences.zh: 太阳总是让它的崇拜者眼睛感到刺痛。
